description: This file contains hardware initialization and control functions for the ITE EC chip on a RISC-V architecture, including PLL configuration, CPU idle management, UART setup, USB PD port management, and system initialization routines.

methods.name: chip_get_pll_freq
methods.description: Returns the current PLL frequency based on hardware register settings.

methods.name: chip_pll_ctrl
methods.description: Controls the PLL mode (sleep or doze) by writing to hardware register.

methods.name: chip_run_pll_sequence
methods.description: Configures and updates the PLL clock dividers and frequency.

methods.name: chip_configure_pll
methods.description: Reconfigures the PLL if current settings differ from desired configuration.

methods.name: chip_change_pll
methods.description: Initializes and sets the PLL configuration during system startup.

methods.name: riscv_idle
methods.description: Enters low-power doze mode, manages interrupts, and wakes up the CPU.

methods.name: arch_cpu_idle
methods.description: Idle routine that manages CPU low-power state, respecting gating conditions.

methods.name: arch_cpu_atomic_idle
methods.description: Atomic idle routine for CPU low-power state.

methods.name: ite_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: System initialization routine for GPIO, UART, USB PD ports, and other hardware components.
